title: The Glue Fingers Problem
question: 把今天的“手很粘 + 正好被打断 + mess 扩散 + 又要签字”放进手工作业场景：用 word bank 补完整 5 个空。
example_answer: I was busy making a model. My hands were covered with sticky glue. At exactly that moment, my phone rang. Nothing could have been more annoying. It took me five minutes to answer the message. What a mess! There was glue on my fingers and on the table. I had no sooner got back to my model than the doorbell rang. A delivery man wanted me to sign for a package.
word_bank: Nothing could have been more annoying
